answer: One concrete defense is requiring each agent to lock a stake bonded to a single verified identity, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive rather than free. Like a glacier moving slowly but carrying real weight, that stake cannot be faked or copied at scale. A cedar grows from one root, not from a forest of clones, and the same applies here: one identity, one bond, with slashing if the agent misbehaves. Honest agents then keep a haven of trust, because bad actors lose their stake when caught, while legitimate participants keep earning.
